_meta.area: Manchester (Ardwick / Hathersage Road, near Manchester Royal Infirmary)
_meta.note: Hand-picked real-world Manchester GP practices and the local NHS hospital, because the NHS Service Search sandbox returns a 50-record canned demo dataset that contains zero Manchester records (see source-verification.md). This file is load-bearing for the demo.
_meta.policy: Every row here must be verifiable on nhs.uk / the practice's own site at demo time. Pharmacies were intentionally NOT pre-baked because we couldn't verify the exact brand+address combos with high enough confidence; the renderer can still point users at 'a local pharmacy' for BP checks via the static officialContent card.
